---
title: "xuload"
---

## Description

Upload datasets to SAS working directory, apply sorting order, and remove process input formats/informats.

## Parameters

**`inds`**

: Name(s) of the input dataset(s)

  *Required:* Yes

**`sourcelib`**

: Name of the input library

  *Required:* Yes

**`sortvars`**

: Sort order for the dataset

  *Required:* No

**`encoding`**

: Encoding for the dataset

  *Required:* No

**`mode`**

: Format/informat processing mode: smart/keep/remove

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `smart`

**`fmtlib`**

: Library with .sas7bcat format catalogs

  *Required:* No

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xuload(dmae,crf,encoding=asciiany,mode=keep,fmtlib=crf);
%xuload(dm,sdtm,sortvars=usubjid);
```
